Tom hopes to visit Rome one day. Tom learned a lot about math. The weather was snowy that day. In fact, a yellow highlighter marks the key dates.
Tom thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like salad and coffee. The classroom is one of the best places in the city. He studies Spanish in an evening class.
Last Wednesday, Tom and David went to the classroom. Tom likes snowy days best. There are always many people at the science lab. Also, it's possible to walk there in an hour.
Tom and David had great fun there. Tom usually has salad for breakfast. Tom's favorite animal is the cat.
